name: EasyGerber
description: AI PCB design, layout, and routing. Use published catalog parts to create and edit schematics, generate PCB layouts, inspect previews and checks, and export board files. Guest discovery needs no account; guest operations require a private session limited to one board. Account-board operations require EasyGerber OAuth; this entry advertises guest access only. Placement, routing and scoring run on EasyGerber's proprietary servers.
author: EasyGerber
